sloka: अस्त्रेणापि हि बद्धस्य भयं मम न जायते ।पितामहमहेन्द्राभ्यां रक्षितस्यानिलेन च ।। ५.४८.४४।।।।
transliteration: astreṇāpi hi baddhasya bhayaṁ mama na jāyate ।pitāmahamahendrābhyāṁ rakṣitasyānilena ca ।। 5.48.44।।।।

translations.english: 'If I am caught by the demon I will have the opportunity to see the demon lord. Therefore, let me be caught by my enemies'.
